questions.question: To what are those who trust in the LORD compared in Psalm 125?
options: A spring of water that never runs dry
A tower of bronze that no army takes
Mount Zion, which cannot be moved
A tree of life that bears fruit always
questions.answer: Mount Zion, which cannot be moved

questions.question: How does the psalm picture God's protection of his people?
options: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people
As the rain waters the earth, so the LORD blesses the faithful
As the sun rises over the hills, so the LORD shines on the just
As the rivers flow to the sea, so the nations stream to Zion
questions.answer: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people

questions.question: The psalm prays for peace upon Israel.
Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be _____.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his _____.
